description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the NXP PCF857x GPIO expanders, including functions for reading/writing pins, handling interrupts, and device initialization.

methods.name: pcf857x_process_input
methods.description: Reads the current pin states from the PCF857x device via I2C.

methods.name: pcf857x_work_handler
methods.description: Handles deferred work for processing input changes and firing callbacks.

methods.name: pcf857x_int_gpio_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for GPIO level changes, triggers work submission.

methods.name: pcf857x_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw port value from the device, ensuring correct configuration.

methods.name: pcf857x_port_set_raw
methods.description: Writes raw port value to the device via I2C.

methods.name: pcf857x_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures individual GPIO pins on the device.

methods.name: pcf857x_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets specific bits on the port.

methods.name: pcf857x_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode for a pin.

methods.name: pcf857x_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, configures GPIO and I2C, sets up callbacks.
